answer: Build a bridge of trust across identities with a work-bonded reputation ledger: an agent's attestations only count after it completes paid, verifiable jobs, and its bond is slashed if it vouches for a fake. Every newcomer starts at the dawn of zero trust and earns weight only through a slow history of honest work, so an attacker facing an ocean of honest agents must fund thousands of separate, costly work histories, each expensive to build and easy to lose, making a fake-identity flood uneconomic.
